planets.name: TOI-4311 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4311 with a 15.1-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-4311 c was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-4311. Its orbit and size follow Eschen et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
